p.i: divites secuta non sis. Quamobrem bonō animo, filia: quicquid postulas, tibi faciam. Scit enim cuncta meorū populari-um civitas, te mulierem esse virtute praeditam. Ruth 3.

Nabalis audita morte, David Iová[?] gratias egit, qui suam contumeliam in Nabalem animadvertisset, seque a scelere prohibuisset, et Nabalus scelus in ipsius caput retorsisset: misitque qui cum Abigaile de ea ad se in matrimonium ducenda agerent. Cum igitur Davidis servi ad Abigailem in Carmelū venissent, eiqué retulissent, se ad eam missos esse a David, quo eam uxorem duceret: surrexit illa, & honore demisse prabito[?], respondit, se illius esse servam, parata velut servorum eius lavare pedes. Deinde protinus proficiscitur, & asino insidens, comitantibus quinque pedissequis, nuncios Davidis subsequitur, illique nu-bit. 1.Reg.25.
Sed offensus Davidis facinore Iehova[?], misit ei Nathanè, qui eum aggressus est his verbis: Duo homines erant in quadi ur-

page.notes: The line "1.Reg.25." and "Ruth 3." are references set in the text, not marginal notes. Doubtful readings: "Iová" after "David" (accent or abbreviation mark unclear), "prabito" (possibly a verb such as prostrato; the word is not clear), "Iehova" after "facinore" (the first letters are unclear). The catchword "be," completes the word "urbe" begun at the line end. Long s is transcribed as plain s throughout.
